Name Tag Maker

Make classic "Hello, my name is" name tags — a full printable sheet of 4, 6 or 8 tags with your name.

The sheet is an A4-ratio PNG — print at 100% scale and cut along the guides. Your name is remembered in this browser only.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your name and an optional subtitle (role, company…).
  2. Choose 4, 6 or 8 tags per sheet and an accent color.
  3. The sheet preview updates live.
  4. Click "Download sheet" to save the printable PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I print the tags?

The sheet is an A4-ratio PNG (1240 × 1754 px) you can print at home or at a print shop and cut apart.

How many tags per sheet?

4 large, 6 medium or 8 compact tags per sheet — pick what fits your event.

Does it remember my name?

Yes — the sheet keeps your last name and subtitle saved in this browser so repeat events are quick.
